scripts.build-win: npm run bundle && pkg dist/app.mjs --no-bytecode --public --public-packages "*" --targets node24-win-x64 --output dist/canvas-scraper-win.exe
scripts.build-mac: npm run bundle && pkg dist/app.mjs --no-bytecode --public --public-packages "*" --targets node24-macos-arm64 --output dist/canvas-scraper-mac
scripts.build-linux: npm run bundle && pkg dist/app.mjs --no-bytecode --public --public-packages "*" --targets node24-linux-x64 --output dist/canvas-scraper-linux
scripts.build: npm run build-win && npm run build-mac && npm run build-linux
